messages:
Sam (data-eng): Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to hand off remediation plan for missing spans + ETL lag. TL;DR: three action items: 1) invariant audit checks, 2) aggregation sanity checks, 3) backfill/monitoring. Assign owners?

Maya (observability): I'll take the invariant audit checks. Plan to add a nightly job that validates total span counts per service vs. ingestion. Draft query below.

Maya (observability): SQL snippet:
```
select service, date_trunc('hour', ts) as hour, count(*) as spans
from spans_raw
where ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
group by service, hour;
```
Compare against `spans_ingested` totals; alert if delta > 1%.

Tina (analytics): I'll own aggregation sanity checks. Will add two checks: cardinality drift and summation vs raw totals. ETA EOW.

Alex (infra): I'll handle the ETL lag root cause: suspected S3-to-queue backpressure. Need to instrument queue depth + S3 transfer latency. Can we get `ops-agent` to emit queue metrics to datadog?

Sam (data-eng): @Alex yes please. Also add a short runbook step to fail-fast and route to fallback aggregator when lag > 5m.

OpsBot: incident-bot: Created follow-up issue #INC-482 on Jira assigned to Sam, Maya, Tina, Alex. (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-482)

Maya (observability): For ownership/timeline: I'll prototype audit job + alert rule by Thursday. Then hand off to platform for prod rollout.

Tina (analytics): EOW for tests, next-week for rollout. Will add unit tests for aggregator logic and a canary job for a week.

Alex (infra): Instrumentation PR ready in 2 days. Will add queue metrics and a dashboard. Also propose adding a periodic end-to-end heartbeat that writes a marker span.

Leo (sre): I'm happy to watch the canary and do on-call paging threshold. Suggest we use `pager:high` only if delta > 5% for 15m.

Sam (data-eng): Good. Action items summary: Maya: invariant audit job (Thu). Tina: aggregator checks + tests (EOW). Alex: queue metrics + heartbeat (2d). Leo: paging thresholds + canary watch. Sam: backfill plan + Jira ticket owner. I'll post the backfill plan here once drafted.

Tina (analytics): Quick question — for backfill, do we prefer incremental windowed reprocessing or full reingest? My vote: incremental with idempotent upserts.

Sam (data-eng): incremental + idempotent. We'll need dedupe keys; I'll draft SQL and steps. ETA for plan tomorrow.

Maya (observability): adding a persistent "missing-spans-invariant" alert and a dashboard panel :white_check_mark:

Alex (infra): ack, will link dashboard to the Jira ticket.

Sam (data-eng): thanks everyone. Follow-up check-in on Friday standup. :calendar:
